title: CRA evidence record (per product version)
description: One record per product version placed on the EU market, generated by the build and release pipeline. Every field carries 'x-cra-basis': the legal basis as summarised in the CRA knowledge base (reports/sections/NN-*.md, reports/guides/application/NN-*.md). The knowledge base paraphrases mirror text; confirm exact wording against the OJ text of Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 before relying on it. Schema versioning: semantic; additive optional fields are minor, any change to required fields or enums is major.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to.
schema_version.x-cra-basis: Design field (no legal basis). Needed so records stay readable for the full retention period (Art 13(13); reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

record_id.x-cra-basis: Annex VII point 1: software versions affecting compliance must be identifiable (reports/sections/10-conformity.md; reports/guides/corporate/08-evidence.md 'Single index').

generated_at.description: UTC time the pipeline generated the record.
generated_at.x-cra-basis: Art 31: documentation drawn up before placing on the market (reports/sections/10-conformity.md). Timestamp proves sequencing under Art 13(12).

product.x-cra-basis: Annex V point 1 (unique identification) and Annex VII point 1 (general description) (reports/sections/10-conformity.md); Annex II point 3 (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md).

product_id.x-cra-basis: Annex V point 1; Annex II point 3 (unique identification).

name.x-cra-basis: Annex V point 1; Annex II point 3.

product_type.x-cra-basis: Art 30(1) CE marking differs for software and hardware (reports/sections/10-conformity.md); placing judged per unit for hardware and per version for standalone software (guidance paras 13-14, reports/sections/03-scope.md).

family.x-cra-basis: Guidance paras 174-177: one file and one declaration may cover a product family (reports/sections/10-conformity.md; reports/guides/application/11-documentation-set.md).

variants.x-cra-basis: Guidance paras 174-177: the declaration must clearly identify the variants (reports/guides/application/11-documentation-set.md).

version.x-cra-basis: Annex VII point 1: software versions affecting compliance (reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

release_date.x-cra-basis: Art 13(9): each security update available for at least 10 years after issue (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md Table 2).

previous_version.x-cra-basis: Guidance pts 104-112: the substantial-modification test compares against the last assessed version (reports/sections/03-scope.md; reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

artefact.x-cra-basis: Annex VII point 1 and point 2(b) (secure update distribution): the shipped artefact the evidence is bound to (reports/guides/application/06-sbom.md 'Generation from the shipped artefact').

placing_on_market.x-cra-basis: Art 3(21) placing on the market; guidance paras 13-14 (per unit; per version for standalone software; all copies of a version deemed placed at first commercial offering) (reports/sections/03-scope.md).

date.x-cra-basis: Guidance paras 13-14 (reports/sections/03-scope.md); start of the Art 13(13) retention clock (reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

event.x-cra-basis: Guidance pt 116: a substantial modification is a new placing on the market (reports/sections/10-conformity.md); non-substantial updates do not reset the placing date (reports/sections/03-scope.md).

member_states.x-cra-basis: Art 28: declaration in the languages of the Member States of sale (reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

classification.x-cra-basis: Arts 7-8, Annexes III-IV; Art 32 routes (reports/sections/06-classification.md; reports/sections/10-conformity.md 'Routes by class').

class.x-cra-basis: Annex III Class I and II, Annex IV (reports/sections/06-classification.md).

annex_category.x-cra-basis: Annex III / IV category as described in Implementing Regulation 2025/2392 (reports/sections/06-classification.md).

harmonised_standards_applied_in_full.x-cra-basis: Art 32(2): Module A for Class I only where an OJ-cited harmonised standard, common specification or scheme is applied in full; none cited as of 30 Oct 2026 (reports/sections/10-conformity.md). Annex VII point 5.

certificate_ref.x-cra-basis: Annex VIII Module B pt 6 / Module H approval; Annex V point 7 (reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

sbom.x-cra-basis: Annex I Part II point 1 (SBOM in a commonly used, machine-readable format covering at least top-level dependencies); Annex VII points 2(b) and 8; Art 13(24)-(25) (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md; reports/guides/application/06-sbom.md).

format.x-cra-basis: 'commonly used and machine-readable format' (Annex I Part II(1)); no Art 13(24) format act adopted (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md). BSI TR-03183-2 (non-binding) prefers CycloneDX 1.6+ or SPDX 3.0.1+ (reports/guides/application/06-sbom.md).

top_level_dependencies.x-cra-basis: Annex I Part II(1) 'at least top-level dependencies'; 'top-level' is not interpreted by FAQ or guidance (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md).

top_level_complete.x-cra-basis: Annex I Part II(1); TR-03183-2 completeness marking (reports/guides/application/06-sbom.md 'Depth').

contains_vulnerability_data.x-cra-basis: BSI TR-03183-2 section 8.1.14: SBOM 'MUST NOT contain vulnerability information' (non-binding; reports/guides/application/06-sbom.md).

provenance.x-cra-basis: Annex VII point 2(c): production and monitoring processes with validation evidence; Art 13(14) series-production conformity (reports/sections/10-conformity.md; reports/guides/application/11-documentation-set.md part 7). Format choice (in-toto / SLSA v1.0) is a design choice, not a legal requirement.

vulnerability_status.x-cra-basis: Annex I Part I(2)(a) 'without known exploitable vulnerabilities' (reports/sections/07-annex1-part1.md); Annex I Part II(2) and (4); guidance para 218 (not_affected VEX as evidence no Art 14 report was due) (reports/guides/application/06-sbom.md).

known_vulnerability_matches.x-cra-basis: Guidance paras 233-234: a vulnerability is 'known' once in the EUVD or another prominent database (reports/sections/07-annex1-part1.md).

feeds.x-cra-basis: EUVD, CVE/NVD, OSV and CISA KEV correlation as practical release gate (reports/sections/07-annex1-part1.md; reports/guides/application/05-sdlc.md release gate).

tests.x-cra-basis: Annex I Part II(3) effective and regular tests; Annex VII point 6 test reports (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md; reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

risk_assessment.x-cra-basis: Art 13(2)-(4), 13(7); Annex VII point 3 (reports/sections/07-annex1-part1.md 'The Art 13 risk assessment').

applicability_matrix.x-cra-basis: Art 13(3)-(4): state whether and how each Annex I Part I point (2) item applies, with a clear justification for any not applied; Annex VII point 3 (reports/sections/07-annex1-part1.md).

annex_ii_user_information.x-cra-basis: Annex II; Art 13(18); Annex VII point 1(d) (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md 'Annex II user information'; reports/guides/application/11-documentation-set.md).

update_design_note.x-cra-basis: Annex VII point 2(b): technical solutions for secure update distribution (reports/guides/application/07-updates.md 'Design note contents').

cvd_policy.x-cra-basis: Annex I Part II(5); Annex VII point 2(b) (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md).

support_period.x-cra-basis: Art 13(8) at least five years unless expected use is shorter; guidance paras 125-128 (5 years a safeguard, not a default); Art 13(19) end month and year shown at purchase; Annex VII point 4 (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md 'Support period').

justification.x-cra-basis: Art 13(8); Annex VII point 4: information used to determine the support period.

latest_version_rule.x-cra-basis: Art 13(10): Part II point 2 may be met for the latest substantially modified version only, if users can upgrade free of charge (reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md Table 2; reports/guides/application/07-updates.md).

substantial_modification.x-cra-basis: Art 3(30); guidance pts 104-112 (four-question test at pt 110, all-negative means not substantial at pts 111-112), pt 108 (security updates generally not substantial), pt 109 (purpose, boundary or dependency changes), pt 116 (new placing), pts 122-123 (focused re-assessment) (reports/sections/10-conformity.md; reports/sections/03-scope.md).

change_type.x-cra-basis: Guidance pt 108 (security_update generally not substantial) and pt 109 (intended_purpose_change; boundary_or_dependency_change, for example moving encryption to a remote service); Annex I Part II(2) separate security from functionality updates where technically feasible (reports/sections/10-conformity.md; reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md).

bundling_justification.x-cra-basis: Annex I Part II(2): separate security updates 'where technically feasible'; record the reason for any bundling (reports/guides/application/07-updates.md).

assessed_by.description: Role or identity of the human assessor, if any.

conformity_assessment_ref.x-cra-basis: Guidance pts 122-123 (re-assessment focused on modified parts); Annex VIII Module B pt 7 / Module H pt 3.5 change notification (reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

declaration.x-cra-basis: Art 28 and Annex V; Art 13(12) sequencing (documentation, procedure, declaration, CE marking before placing); Annex VII point 7; FAQ 6.8 (new version 'might need a new declaration' after a substantial modification) (reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

uri.x-cra-basis: Art 13(20) and Annex VI: 'the exact internet address' of the full declaration; Annex II point 6 (reports/sections/10-conformity.md).

signer.description: Identity that signs this evidence record (pipeline identity plus the accountable human role).
signer.x-cra-basis: Design field supporting Art 13(22) (conformity information on reasoned request) and integrity of the Annex VII file; guide 05-sdlc 'sign evidence' (reports/guides/application/05-sdlc.md). Not a legal requirement in itself.

retention.x-cra-basis: Art 13(13): technical documentation and declaration kept 10 years after placing or for the support period, whichever is longer; Art 13(18) Annex II information likewise; Art 13(9) updates available 10 years (reports/sections/10-conformity.md; reports/sections/05-roles.md; reports/sections/08-annex1-part2.md).

gate.x-cra-basis: Release security gate record (reports/guides/application/05-sdlc.md; reports/guides/corporate/08-evidence.md). Annex VII point 2(c) production process evidence.

digestedItem.description: A reference to an evidence item with content digests. The digest, not the URI, binds the record to the content.
